versions.changelog:
Initial release: Launch of Go-to-Market Strategy Builder.

- Provides guided templates for full GTM planning, including market positioning, channel strategies, pricing, launch timelines, and success metrics.
- Includes step-by-step launch timeline (12 weeks) and detailed success metrics dashboard.
- Features industry-specific GTM guidance and common mistake warnings.
- Offers supporting tools and links for revenue analysis and GTM workflow automation.
